# monotaur_maintenance_schedule (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur maintenance schedule by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_maintenance_schedule" "weekly_patching" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the maintenance schedule to look up.

### Read-Only

- `apply_to_component_status` (Boolean) Whether the components show as under maintenance while a generated window is active.
- `component_ids` (List of String) IDs of the components the schedule's windows apply to.
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the schedule was created.
- `description` (String) A description of the maintenance, copied to every generated window.
- `exclude_from_downtime` (Boolean) Whether time inside the generated windows is excluded from downtime in uptime reports.
- `schedule` (String) The cron expression for when each window starts.
- `squelch` (Boolean) Whether alarm notifications for the components are suppressed while a generated window is active.
- `time_span` (String) How long each window lasts, as a .NET TimeSpan `[d.]hh:mm:ss`.
- `time_zone_id` (String) The time zone `schedule` is evaluated in, or null for UTC.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the schedule was last updated.
